title.zh: R 1 出生与死亡登记规则
title.en: R 1 BIRTHS AND DEATHS REGISTRATION RULES

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《CAP-79-R-1-BIRTHS-AND-DEATHS-REGISTRATION-RULES.pdf》（14 页），本次切分 11 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: These Rules may be cited as the Births and Deaths Registration Rules.
In these Rules, “Act” means the Births and Deaths Registration Act. Form of Register of Births.
The register required to be kept under the Act for the registration of births shall be in Form A in the First Schedule. Form of Register of Deaths.
The register required to be kept under the Act for the registration of deaths shall be in Form B in the First Schedule. Index Register of Births.
An Index Register of Births registered under the Act shall be kept in Form C in the First Schedule. Index Register of Deaths.
An Index Register of Deaths registered under the Act shall be kept in Form D in the First Schedule. Certified copies of entries in Registers.

For the purposes of section 11(2) of the Act —

(a) a certified copy of an entry in the Register of Births, the Register of Deaths or the Index Register of Deaths shall be a facsimile of such entry with a certificate signed by the Register of Births and Deaths in the words “Certified copy of entry No. ...................” written, typed or printed thereon; and

(b) a certified copy of an entry in the Index Register of Births shall be in Form E in the First Schedule.
(Repealed by S 18/2012). Certificate of late registration of birth.
The certificate for the registration of the name of a child whose birth, without any name having been given, has already been registered shall be in Form H in the First Fees.

The fees to be paid under the Act shall be such as are specified in the Second (rules 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7(b))

REGISTER OF BIRTHS (opposite) (continued)

FORM B

REGISTER OF DEATHS (opposite) Registration Informant Born

INDEX REGISTER OF BIRTHS When Born Name Occupation Name Sex Name No. Informant Registration of Illness of Death Date of Death

INDEX REGISTER OF DEATHS residence before arrival Darussalam continuous residence in Darussalam at Death Day Age Year Name No. (continued)

FORM E

CERTIFIED COPY OF INDEX REGISTER OF BIRTHS (continued)

FORM F

MEDICAL CERTIFICATE OF CAUSE OF DEATH (Repealed by S 18/2012)

FORM G

POST MORTEM EXAMINATION CERTIFICATE (Repealed by S 18/2012)

LATE REGISTRATION OF NAME OF CHILD (to be delivered to the Registrar under section 12) I certify that the name of the child registered by me on  .............................................. under Registration No.  ..................... is  ......................................................  (include the appropriate part of the father’s name). Signature of Parent/Informant  ..................................................................................... Date  ...........................................  Address  ...................................................................... This information was submitted within  ...........................................  months of birth. ..................................................................... Deputy Registrar of Births and Deaths (rule 11)
